Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present, with the value true, only when the answer is the stored replay of an earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key.

400.description: malformed-request (unparseable or empty JSON, an unknown member, trailing data, a body over 64 KiB, or a NUL in the query or body), idempotency-key-required or idempotency-key-invalid.

type.description: /problems/<slug>, for example /problems/over-refund. The slug list is in the API description.

detail.description: Always present; for internal-error it is a fixed generic message.

instance.description: Always present; the escaped request path.

value.title: Idempotency-Key header is required
value.detail: the Idempotency-Key header is required on this operation

404.description: not-found (no such hold), or resource-not-found when the path contains a NUL.

type.description: /problems/<slug>, for example /problems/over-refund. The slug list is in the API description.

detail.description: Always present; for internal-error it is a fixed generic message.

instance.description: Always present; the escaped request path.

409.description: idempotency-key-reused (the key was first used with a different method, path or body), illegal-transition, over-capture, over-refund or hold-expired.

type.description: /problems/<slug>, for example /problems/over-refund. The slug list is in the API description.

detail.description: Always present; for internal-error it is a fixed generic message.

instance.description: Always present; the escaped request path.

value.title: Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request
value.detail: Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request
